title: Les bassins hydrographiques du Cameroun
through_line: On remonte un fleuve : d’abord l’eau, puis les régions qu’elle traverse.

blocks.vo_line: L’hydrographie, c’est l’ensemble des cours d’eau d’une région.
blocks.shot: Many small blue streams running across a wide green plain, seen from high above, morning light.

blocks.vo_line: Un bassin est la région arrosée par un fleuve et ses affluents.
blocks.shot: A green valley with one wide river in the middle and several small rivers joining it from the hills.

blocks.vo_line: Un affluent se jette dans un fleuve plus grand pour le grossir.
blocks.shot: A narrow river flowing into a much wider river, the two waters meeting and swirling together.

blocks.vo_line: Le Cameroun compte quatre bassins : le Tchad, le Niger, l’Atlantique et le Congo.
blocks.shot: Four separate blue ribbons of water flowing away in four different directions over soft green land.

blocks.vo_line: Le Logone arrose Maroua, et la Bénoué arrose Garoua.
blocks.shot: A broad river in a dry savannah passing beside a small town with low houses, acacia trees and boats.

blocks.vo_line: La Sanaga rejoint l’océan, et la Sangha coule dans la forêt.
blocks.shot: A large river widening towards the ocean on the left, and a dark calm river under tall rainforest trees on the right.
